note: One variable per old test, each delivering the old test's occurrences as SCB members of real edition labels, so the reader's `source_scopes` forms the pooled scopes the old tests built with `_pooled_record`. Expected values are the old tests' asserted segments. Two translations. (1) test_explicit_annual_facts_override_pooled_facts_without_conflict's fixture (pooled integer, annual text) cannot show the filter: integer and text widen to text without an issue whether or not the pooled facts are reconciled, and the old test's `occurrences == (annual,)` has no artifact projection. annual-facts keeps that fixture; annual-facts-conflict carries its claim (the middle state has exactly the annual occurrence's facts and no conflict) on a pair that conflicts when reconciled (pooled date, annual integer: the same pair conflicts in occurrence-states-reconcile-facts-on-exact-intervals' w02), so its middle state is the annual integer. (2) test_pooled_scope_without_a_carried_range_stays_unsupported built a pooled '2012 - 2014' scope with its range removed; the projection register (native 310, `_PROJECTION_REGISTERS` in scb_records.py) is the reader that produces exactly that scope. The overlap test's per-edition evidence (`effective_occurrences` once each) has no projection. Since #1296 2d one rule merges every day-adjacent state pair with identical resolved facts, pooled or not, so annual-full's three explicit years are one unpooled state; gap adds the refusal to merge across a missing year.
fails_if: `resolve_occurrence_intervals` (source_intervals.py) reconciles pooled occurrences together with an explicit one covering the same span (annual-facts-conflict's 2013 becomes a date/integer conflict), stops cutting a pooled range around explicit years, marks a span an explicit occurrence covers as pooled, or stops marking pooled-only spans; `merge_adjacent_states` (resolved_catalog.py) stops joining day-adjacent states with identical facts (overlap-same's three pooled cuts, annual-full's three explicit years), joins states whose data_type or provenance differs (overlap-diff), joins a pooled state with an explicit neighbor (adjacent) or joins across a gap (gap); `source_scopes` (source_periods.py) stops reading a 'Läsåren' hull as one pooled school-year range; or the projection register's range-less pooled scope is placed on its delivery years

sources.description: Register TESTREG (1, variant 10). Editions: 1201 '2012 - 2014', 1618 '2016 - 2018', 1820 '2018 - 2020', 1977 'Läsåren 1977/1978 - 2024/2025', and the annual editions 2012..2015. Each variable delivers its members in one column; Datatyp int (integer) unless noted. pool (401): 2012 - 2014 alone. lasaren (402): the Läsåren hull alone. annual-wins (403): 2012 - 2014 and 2013. annual-facts (404): 2012 - 2014 int and 2013 text. annual-facts-conflict (405): 2012 - 2014 date and 2013 int. annual-full (406): 2012 - 2014 and each of 2012, 2013, 2014. overlap-same (407): 2016 - 2018 and 2018 - 2020. overlap-diff (408): the same, the second typed text. adjacent (409): 2012 - 2014 and 2015. gap (410): 2012 and 2014, nothing in 2013. Register PROJECTION (310, variant 3100), a projection register: proj (501) delivers edition 3101 '2012 - 2014'.
